title: Don´t miss it!
text:
Excellent tour, all towns are extremely beautiful. The two medieval towns on the afternoon are awesome, looks you go back on time.
The tour is perfectly organized, punctual, informative and with an excellent guide. Recommended 100%. Best day of my vacations.
author: christinebP3483JJ

title: Excellent Experience
text: It was such a beautiful experience! Monica was very clear and informed. She was also very attentive to everyone on the tour. We were able to have some time in each stop which was a great opportunity to further site see and eat. Appreciate this experience and Monica! Thank you
author: Martha_M

title: The Ultimate tour of Costa Brava all in one easy day.
text: This tour had everything to explore and experience Costa Brava - scenic bus tour, three different old world fishing/resort towns, a hike along the coast between the towns.  A boat ride along the rugged coast with underwater viewing, and lastly stopping at a medieval town.  Lots of free time to explore each area and choice of lunch places on the seaside. The guides were friendly, fun and personable  and knowledgeable about the history and areas. They quickly answered my questions via WhatsApp before the tour. author: E1098MSjamesw

title: Costa Brava dream
text: It was the most breathtaking tour. Our tour guide was sweet, kind & very knowledgeable. The beach was fabulous, the views spectacular, and the boat ride was amazing. We had time for a delicious lunch & coffee. II was a perfect day!!
author: Cecilia_G

title: An outstanding trip
text: This was an outstanding trip that offered a great variety of experiences of Costa Brava all in one day. We highly recomend it. Our guide Monica was exceptional with her commentary on the area. She had extensive knowledge while at the same time didn't overload us with too much detail. Great value for money.
author: RossM

title: Amazing experience
text:
The 11h tour of the Costa Brava seemed like a great idea to know the most relevant and beautiful of the area in just one day. It is an excursion to go with energy and eager to know the landscapes of the Costa Brava. There is some free time to eat and observe the views in some parts of the tour but it is rather a tour to move while you are visiting the towns that it includes, all beautiful and with a lot of history. 

On hot days the air-conditioned bus is very grateful. Indispensable to wear sun cream! 

100% recommended!
author: MariaBenito7

author: Karen P

title: Excellent tour
text: This is an excellent full day tour of the Costa Brava plus a stop at a Medieval village dating from the 12th century.  The tour is both informative and fully packed.  A tour of the Greek and Roman ruins of Empurres was extremely informative and would be of interest to any student of history.  A particular shout out of Jorge, our guide,  who not only provided excellent commentary but spent time one on one with each member of our tour group.  Again, and excellent introduction to the beautiful Costa Brava!
author: edisong2013

title: Wonderful tour...great guide
text: I highly recommend this tour.  It was a full day of beautiful sights and lots to do.   We had a wonderful guide who kept us informed and entertained.  Thank you, Jorge!
author: popandsas

title: Terrific day in Costa Brava
text: Excellent day tour - it was a terrific way to see a variety of Costa Brava sights all in a single day which we would have been hard pressed to do in our own. The weather was perfect that day and our guide, Jorge, was quite informative as well as being fun and upbeat. Wonderful short hike on the coast between villages to start the day with ample photo opportunities and I especially enjoyed the Greek and Roman ruins at Emporia at the end of the day. All in all, well worth it.
author: Reviver789
